Private Sushi Experience

Private Sushi

A working Edomae sushi chef prepares omakase, right in your suite.

A special offering for guests of our stay
Welcome

Your room becomes a private sushi counter.

During your stay, a working Edomae sushi chef comes to your room and prepares an omakase course piece by piece, right before your eyes — all in the privacy of your own space. A memorable moment for family and friends, or a special way to celebrate an occasion, without ever stepping out.

The Chef
Rihito
Edomae Sushi Chef

A working sushi chef at a high-end Edomae sushi restaurant in Tokyo. Honoring traditional Edomae techniques, he tailors each course to your taste and pace, crafting every piece with care. As he prioritizes his restaurant, private engagements are available on limited dates only.

The Experience

Chef’s omakase and a hands-on experience, in one.

A special plan that combines an authentic Edomae omakase with a make-together experience. Savor the sushi the chef prepares, and enjoy shaping pieces together with your family or group.

1Omakase (chef’s nigiri)

Using seasonal ingredients, the chef prepares a 10–12 piece omakase, shaping each piece right in front of you.

2Make-together experience

Shape and taste sushi together with your family or group — a hands-on moment kids can join too, and a lasting travel memory.

The content can be adjusted to your preferences — feel free to let us know your group size and tastes.

How to Book

Booking in three simple steps.

1

1 · Message your host

Send us an Airbnb message with your preferred date, number of guests, and whether children will join.

2

2 · Receive your plan

The chef will ask about group size, ages, and any celebration, then propose the best plan for your party.

3

3 · Confirm & enjoy

Once the details and price are set, your booking is confirmed. On the day, enjoy authentic Edomae sushi shaped in your room.

Reservations are first-come, first-served. If you’re interested, please reach out early.
Good to Know

Before you book

Dietary care

Beyond allergies and dietary restrictions, we can prepare alternatives — seared, grilled, steamed, or simmered — for guests who don’t eat raw fish. Religious restrictions and kid-friendly options are welcome; just let us know in advance.

On the day

The chef brings all ingredients, tools, and supplies. From preparation to serving each piece fresh, to cleaning up afterward — everything is taken care of, so you can simply relax. Please have a space in your room suitable for preparation and dining.

Cancellation

As ingredients are sourced individually for each booking, cancellations and refunds cannot be accepted once your booking is confirmed. Thank you for your understanding.
